stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Live voice models for simultaneous conversation

key_facts.fact: OpenAI launched GPT-Live on July 8, 2026, as a new generation of voice models for more natural ChatGPT conversations.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, the company launched GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models that aims to make talking with AI feel even more like having a conversation with a human.

key_facts.fact: GPT-Live uses a full-duplex architecture that enables simultaneous listening and speaking.
key_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the upgrade is a new full-duplex architecture, which enables simultaneous listening and speaking, reducing latency and creating a more natural experience.

key_facts.fact: The voice model can offload deeper reasoning to GPT-5.5 at launch while continuing the conversation.
key_facts.excerpt: When a query requires deeper reasoning, GPT-Live offloads that request to another model, GPT 5.5 at launch, and then processes it in the background so that it can keep the discussion going with you.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1 for ChatGPT Voice users on Go, Plus, and Pro plans, with GPT-Live-1 Mini as the default for free users.
key_facts.excerpt: Starting today, OpenAI is rolling out two versions of GPT Live: GPT-Live-1, powering ChatGPT Voice for Go, Plus, and Pro Users, and GPT-Live-1 Mini, the default for free users.

sources.title: How OpenAI's voice assistant got more natural

key_facts.excerpt: We find 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks to be broken.

stories.headline: Cognition releases SWE-1.7, a coding model served at 1,000 TPS

key_facts.fact: Cognition launched SWE-1.7 on July 8, 2026, calling it the most capable model it had trained so far.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're launching SWE-1.7, the most capable model we've trained so far.

key_facts.fact: Cognition said SWE-1.7 was trained from a Kimi K2.7 base after Kimi had already undergone extensive RL post-training.
key_facts.excerpt: Since SWE-1.7 was trained from a Kimi K2.7 base, which had already undergone extensive RL post-training, the large additional gains from our own training challenge the idea of a 'post-training ceiling'.

key_facts.fact: SWE-1.7 is available in Devin web, desktop, and CLI via Cerebras at 1,000 tokens per second.
key_facts.excerpt: SWE-1.7 is available today in Devin (Web, Desktop, and CLI) via Cerebras at 1000 TPS.

key_facts.fact: Cognition reported pass rates of 42.3% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, 81.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 77.8% on SWE-Bench Multilingual.
key_facts.excerpt: FrontierCode 1.1 Main 42.3%; Terminal-Bench 2.1 81.5%; SWE-Bench Multilingual 77.8%.

key_facts.fact: The company said its RL training spans four datacenters across three continents.
key_facts.excerpt: Our RL training spans four datacenters across three continents, combining our own GPUs across multiple clusters with additional compute from inference providers like Fireworks.
